image_description: A low-angle shot of a large, white parabolic satellite dish (radio telescope) angled towards the sky. The dish surface appears to be made of solid panels with visible seams. A complex metal support structure holds the feed horn assembly at the focal point. The background consists of green treetops and a pale blue sky with light clouds.

The thin metal struts holding the central receiver appear to merge slightly into the background sky and the dish surface without crisp occlusion boundaries, suggesting minor geometric bleeding or fusion.
The elliptical rim has slight irregularities in thickness and smoothness, deviating from the perfect geometric ellipse expected of a rigid manufactured object.
